description: Intentional changes to frozen first-party UI files. Each entry records the original hash, the reviewed hash, why it changed, and which tests cover the behavior.

assets.reason: sendMessage, runAssistantTurn and driveAssistantSse split into named functions of 60 lines or fewer, with awaits kept at the same points so sends and turns start in the same tick as before. A finished failed reply refreshes its Retry action.
A failed last reply gets a visible Retry action that re-sends the user's message through the existing unchanged-edit path.
Stream start and end refresh Retry actions, so Retry hides while a turn runs.

When the chat column is narrow (sidebar and Activity open), the composer uses the existing compact Branch button and keeps its tools on one row instead of stacking them; the empty capabilities label stays on one line.
verifiedBy: Visual check at 1024px with sidebar and Activity open, idle and streaming

assets.reason: Style for the always-visible Retry action on a failed reply, matching the other message actions.
verifiedBy: Visual check of a failed reply
